postings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Anthropic (m/f/d)
postings.location: Berlin, Berlin, Germany; Hamburg, Hamburg, Germany; München, Bavaria, Germany
postings.description:
About us

Artefact is a data and AI services company with around 2,500 people across 36 offices. We are part of Anthropic's Claude Partner Network and have rolled out Claude across our own organization, so our advice to clients comes from running it ourselves first.

DeployCo is Artefact's team dedicated to deploying Claude at scale inside enterprises. It works through three levers. Deployment and adoption gets organizations from a few early adopters to company-wide use. Process reimagination redesigns core workflows around agentic AI. Agent production ships working agents into client systems. Forward Deployed Engineers are the builders behind the third lever and the technical backbone of the other two.

The role

As an FDE you join a client's own AI or engineering team as a builder, not an advisor. You design, code, and ship production-grade Claude solutions directly inside their stack, following their conventions, repositories, and CI. You also leave the capability behind, so that when the engagement ends the client's engineers can extend and maintain what was built without us.
The work ranges from short, intense engagements, like standing up a governed Claude Code deployment in a few weeks, to longer embeds where you become the technical anchor of a multi-agent portfolio and a larger Artefact pod grows around you. This is a senior role, and we expect you to own technical direction on an engagement from the first week.

What you'll do

- Build production agents. Design and deploy Claude-based agents and workflows that run in production, with the engineering standards that implies. That means tests, error handling, monitoring, and cost control.

- Connect Claude to enterprise systems. Build custom MCP servers and connectors to business applications and data sources, enforcing the client's own access rules. This includes permissions, traceability, and segregation of rights.

- Engineer the context layer. Contribute to Artefact's context platform approach, including deterministic authentication before data reaches the model, user-level context injection, and observability for token spend and security.

- Deploy and govern Claude Code. Set up SSO and role-based access, managed settings, approved MCP servers and plugin marketplaces, permission modes, sandboxing, and OpenTelemetry-based usage monitoring. Help clients choose between deployment options (Team, Enterprise, cloud providers, gateways) based on security, data residency, and cost.

- Build reusable skills. Turn client workflows into Claude Skills and shared skills libraries that teams can find, reuse, and build on.

- Enable client engineers. Pair program, review code, document patterns, and deliver hands-on Claude Code training and labs, sometimes to cohorts of dozens of developers and sometimes to CTOs and engineering leaders.

- Feed the product loop. Capture deployment pitfalls and product feedback from the field and share it with Anthropic through our partnership.

What you bring

- Senior-level experience in software engineering or data science, with production systems you have shipped and operated

- Recent, hands-on work with the GenAI stack, going beyond prototypes. This includes tool use, agent design, retrieval, evaluation, and prompt and context engineering.

- Demonstrated depth with Claude in particular, such as Claude Code, the Claude API, Skills, or MCP, and a point of view on how the stack is evolving

- Strong Python or TypeScript, and solid grounding in enterprise integration, including APIs, identity and access management (SSO, OAuth, SCIM), and cloud platforms

- Confidence in client-facing settings, explaining technical trade-offs to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders, and running a workshop when needed

- Fluent in German and English 

Nice to have

- Anthropic certification (Claude Certified Developer or Architect) is welcome but not expected, since it is usually only available through a partner company. We support you in earning it once you join.

- Experience building and securing MCP servers

- Background in security, observability (OpenTelemetry), or FinOps for AI workloads

- Experience in regulated industries such as banking, asset management, or pharma

- A track record of teaching or technical training

What we offer

- Direct work with Anthropic's partner and applied AI teams, including co-delivered labs

- Varied, high-impact engagements across EMEA in finance, retail, industry, and consumer goods

- A clear path from FDE to technical anchor of a full AI delivery pod

- Certification support and dedicated learning time

Don't worry if you don't meet all the criteria! At Artefact, we value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else.If you are excited about shaping the future of AI and ready to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Diversity & Inclusion at Artefact > We believe that unique perspectives fuel innovation. At Artefact, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome and consider all applications purely based on merit, skills, and potential - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, age, background, or disability. Come as you are!

Ready to take the next step? Please submit your CV showcasing your experience and passion for this role as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Anthropic (m/f/d). We look forward to receiving your application!

If you have any questions, feel free to send us a message at bewerbungen-de@artefact.com.

postings.title: Growth Tribe
postings.description:
tl;dr

- Part of the leadership team of Artefact, you contribute to our growth, in terms of strategy, organisation, business, you name it!

- Salary range: A competitive fixed salary, and your variable from Group-level Bonus Pool.

- Our working language is in English, but it's always easier when you speak the local language(s) ;)

The team

Artefact's Growth Tribe, or The Tribe, is the leading force of Artefact and all of our business units! True to its name, the Tribe today is composed of more than 100 people around the world of all expertises, piloting our growth regarding our business, but also our development strategy and organisational operations.

Leading by examples, the Tribe accompanies our teams through challenging calls for tenders and all-night-long summer parties, brainstorming for impacting data solutions but also the destination options for our offsite trips. Kudo to them, and soon, to you!

Mission

- Creating real impact with clients: You win consulting engagements and oversee their delivery, transform data into added value and make sure our clients reap all the benefits.

- Bringing your industry expertise to help both our own and our client teams develop themselves.

- Leading the team in supporting our clients’ top executives (CMO, CDO, sometimes directly the CEO) with transformation of their business and making sure Artefact is their preferred partner in this endeavor.

Desirable skills

You have solid years of experience in relevant fields (strategy consulting, data & technologies, digital marketing) and you have good knowledge of Artefact's domain of expertise.

You are a thought leader on topics at the intersection of data, marketing, and technology; expertise in one or more industry verticals

Client relation is nothing new for you: You have business development mindset, with experience building, growing, and managing a roust book of business.

Why should you join us

- Artefact is the place to be: come and build the future of data and marketing

- Innovation: We have a passion for creating impacting projects, and believe innovation can come from anyone.

- Action: We make things rather than telling people how to make them.

- Collaboration: We believe in bringing talented people together, in winning together, and in learning from each other.

Come join us!

postings.title: HR Manager:in (m/w/d) mit Fokus Recruiting
postings.description:
Über Artefact

Artefact ist ein weltweit führendes Dienstleistungsunternehmen, das sich auf Daten- und KI-Services spezialisiert hat, mit Hauptsitz in Paris. Wir kombinieren die Struktur und die lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise der Top-Management-Beratung mit tiefgehendem Expertenwissen in den Bereichen Data, AI und Analytics. Mit weltweit über 2.000 Consultants, Data Scientists und Engineers in 26 Ländern arbeiten wir partnerschaftlich mit globalen Marktführern zusammen.

Unser deutsches Team befindet sich auf einem starken Wachstumskurs und schlägt die Brücke zwischen technologischen Möglichkeiten und geschäftlichen Notwendigkeiten. Um dieses Wachstum stabil zu halten, suchen wir für unser HR-Team in München ab sofort in Vollzeit eine zuverlässige und strukturierte Persönlichkeit als HR Manager:in mit Fokus Recruiting. 

Im HR Bereich fühlst du dich zu Hause? Du kommunizierst stark, organisierst gut, bringst Empathie mit und zeichnest dich durch Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein aus? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Als HR Manager:in mit Fokus Recruiting (m/w/d) liegt dein Schwerpunkt im Recruiting und Employer Branding. Darüber hinaus arbeitest du an Themen der Personalentwicklung, HR Management und HR Projekten mit. 

Dies ist dein Schwerpunkt:

Recruiting & Employer Branding

- Involvierung im gesamten Recruiting-Prozess sowie aktive (Mit-)Gestaltung dessen

- Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung von Interviews für verschiedene Positionen sowie aktive Ansprache von Kandidat:innen über LinkedIn

- Planung von und Teilnahme an Personal- und Hochschulmarketing-Veranstaltungen

- Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Employer Brandings

HR Management 

- Beratung von Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften in arbeitsrechtlichen Fragestellungen

- Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender

- Allgemeine Personalverwaltung: Vertragserstellung und -anpassungen, Erstellung von Bescheinigungen und Arbeitszeugnissen, etc.

- Pflege von Personalverwaltungstools (u.A. Personio)

People Analytics & Prozesse

- Begleitung und Koordination des jährlichen Performance-Review-Prozesses

- Überarbeitung bestehender Prozesse zur Optimierung interner Abläufe

- Erstellung und Überarbeitung von Policies

- Unterstützung bei der Digitalisierung und Automatisierung von Prozessen und Tool-Implementierungen

HR Projektmanagement & Strategie

- Unterstützung verschiedener HR-Projekte, wie z.B. Feedbackprozesse, Mitarbeitendenbindung oder Personalentwicklung

- Mitarbeit in strategischen Projekten wie bspw. bei Recherchen, Analysen und Präsentationserstellung

Das wünschen wir uns von dir:

- 

Du bringst ca. 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Recruiting in einer vergleichbaren HR-Position in einem Start-up, einer Unternehmensberatung oder einem ähnlich dynamischen Umfeld, idealerweise mit internationalem Bezug, mit

- Mindestens verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, die du in der täglichen Abstimmung mit deutschen und internationalen Stakeholdern und Teams sicher und selbstverständlich einsetzt

- Erfahrung in der Führung strukturierter Interviews und in der Bewerbendenauswahl

- Gute arbeitsrechtliche Kenntnisse

- Erfahrung in der Nutzung und Pflege eines HRIS, idealerweise Personio o. Ä.

- Abgeschlossenes Studium oder abgeschlossene Ausbildung, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Personal

- Durchsetzungsvermögen, Umsetzungsstärke sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit

- Selbstbewusstes Auftreten sowie eine eigenverantwortliche, proaktive und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise

Das wäre ein Plus:

- Erste Erfahrungen im Active Sourcing, idealerweise über LinkedIn

- Sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse und gute bis sehr gute Google-Workspace-Kenntnisse

Warum Artefact?

- HR mit Tech-Edge: Bei uns arbeitest du am Puls der Zeit und gestaltest ein modernes Unternehmen aktiv mit.

- Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du arbeitest direkt mit unserer Head of HR und unserem C-Level Management zusammen und bekommst Einblick in alle Bereiche unseres Unternehmens. Ein strukturiertes Onboarding und Training on the Job in unseren spezifischen Tools und Prozessen geben dir dafür das nötige Fundament.

- Kurze Wege & persönlicher Austausch: Unser HR Team arbeitet eng und vertrauensvoll zusammen. Wir schätzen den persönlichen und kontinuierlichen Austausch, digital sowie gelegentlich vor Ort, um gemeinsam die besten Lösungen zu entwickeln und kurze Entscheidungswege zu nutzen.

- Culture of Doers: Wir verbinden professionelle Umsetzung mit einem äußerst hilfsbereiten Team. Wir arbeiten unternehmerisch, bewegen uns schnell und unterstützen uns gegenseitig bei der persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.

- Flexibilität & Sicherheit: Wir bieten dir eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und einem modernen Remote-Arbeitsmodell, das gelegentliche Office-Besuche nach Absprache erfordert.

Keine Sorge, wenn du nicht alle Kriterien zu 100 % erfüllst! Bei Artefact schätzen wir Motivation, pragmatische Problemlösungskompetenz und Flexibilität über alles. Wenn du für neue Herausforderungen brennst und Lust darauf hast, Effizienz aktiv mitzugestalten, wollen wir dich kennenlernen.

postings.title: Intern - Assistant Strategic Planner - Artefact 3000 - Paris
postings.description:
QUI SOMMES-NOUS 

Artefact 3000 est l’agence créative intégrée d’Artefact qui combine le talent créatif au savoir-faire data & IA. L’agence puise son inspiration dans le réel et les insights précis pour concevoir des idées qui résonnent et marquent les esprits sur tous les terrains de jeu créatifs, de l’IA aux médias intemporels. 

Basée à Paris, Artefact 3000 compte 65 collaborateurs et accompagne ses clients dans la définition de leur stratégie de communication, la conception et le déploiement de campagnes intégrées, l’animation des réseaux sociaux, et la production digitale (contenus, expériences digitales, sites web).

Le planning chez 3000

Le planning au sein de 3000, c’est une mission décomposée en 3 tiers : 

- Accompagnement annuel de nos clients : copy strat, brief créatifs, analyse de cible et tendances, bench pub

- Accompagnement sur les appels d’offre

- Accompagnement ponctuel sur des missions “avec le conseil” pour apporter de la culture conso sur des sujets de marketing stratégique ou sur des projets d’”innovation IA” 

Par accompagnement, nous entendons : être embarqué avec un planneur et apprendre le métier en l’accompagnant. Faire des benchmarks, comprendre les catégories, décoder les tendances, s’immerger dans les réseaux sociaux, apprendre à formaliser sa pensée à travers des éléments simples qui sauront influer un brief créatif. 

Profil 

- Passionné.e de pub. Avant tout.

- Forte curiosité et esprit critique pour les outils IA

- Ayant déjà effectué un stage de 6 mois au planning dans une agence créative 

- Option : diplômé(e) d’une École de Commerce ou d’une École de Communication 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

- Artefact est l'endroit où il faut être: venez construire l'avenir de la com dans la seule agence de pub appartenant au leader européen de l’IA. 

- Progression: chaque jour offre de nouveaux défis et de nouvelles opportunités d'apprendre

postings.title: IT Support Assistant
postings.description:
Who We Are

Artefact is an applied AI company. We build systems that run in production, in our clients' own cloud, and keep running after we leave. We are present in 27 countries across all continents with a team of 2,500 employees and offer the most comprehensive set of AI & data solutions per industry, built on deep data science and cutting-edge AI technologies, delivering AI projects at scale in all industry sectors. From strategy to operations, we partner with 1000+ clients, including some of the world’s top 300 brands.

The Role

We are looking for an IT Support Assistant reporting directly to our IT Director (Located in the UK) and working closely with our People and Finance team you will look after our internal workplace systems, office network, and meeting room technology. As our company continues to grow, you will play a crucial role in keeping our day-to-day operations running smoothly and helping our team solve everyday technical challenges.

This role combines hands-on IT troubleshooting, admin support, and hardware coordination. Working closely with the IT Director, you will help manage the full employee lifecycle—from setting up laptops for new starters to managing user accounts, updating hardware, and maintaining office technology.

The ideal candidate is dynamic, friendly, proactive, and engaging—someone who brings a hands-on, "roll up your sleeves" attitude and loves helping people get the most out of their technology.

What You'll Do

Deliver Everyday IT Support

- Provide User Support: Act as the main point of contact for day-to-day IT queries, supporting colleagues face-to-face, over internal messaging systems, or by phone.

- Troubleshoot & Fix Issues: Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and basic network issues across both Windows and Mac devices, swapping out parts or running repairs where needed.

- Manage Tickets: Keep track of open support requests, prioritizing and managing many cases at one time to resolve user issues promptly.

- Meeting Room Tech: Maintain and support our office meeting room technology to ensure smooth hybrid meetings and presentations.

- Guides & Training: Create clear written or video "how-to" guides and run friendly IT inductions for new joiners to help everyone navigate our systems easily.

Administer Systems & Devices

- Account Administration: Create, set up, and manage user and computer accounts within Google Workspace, Office 365 and ManageEngine Endpoint Central.

- Onboarding & Offboarding: Partner closely with HR to ensure new starters have their tech ready on day one, and manage smooth IT offboarding for departing staff.

- Inventory Control: Maintain a full, up-to-date IT inventory for company assets, reconcile this with the finance asset register, and manage comms/storage room stock.

- Device Security & Warranties: Administer ESET Endpoint Security & Encryption to ensure all company laptops are protected, seek approval from the IT Director for equipment purchase requirements, log and schedule Dell or supplier warranty repairs, and arrange compliant equipment disposal (WEEE certificates).

Assist with IT Projects & Upgrades

- Evaluate & Research: Research new systems and test new technology as agreed with the IT Director, making recommendations for company adoption.

- Office & Tech Moves: Assist with all IT-related aspects of office relocations, expansions, or mergers.

- Starter, Exit & Freelance Process: Take project management responsibility for the new starter, exit, and freelance technology process—ensuring budget is requested, machines are ordered, and hardware is configured in a timely fashion.

What We're Looking For

- End-User Support: Approximately 2 years of experience supporting end users across Windows and Apple devices.

- Cloud & Admin Skills: Knowledge of user administration within Office 365, Google Workspace, Active Directory, and MDM solutions.

- Customer-First Mindset: Friendly, proactive, and engaging approach to customer service with strong communication skills.

- Self-Organization: Ability to manage your own time, prioritizing and dealing with workload on your own initiative.

- Certifications & Skills: CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, or printer support experience.

- Availability & Location: Available full-time with the ability to travel to our Utrecht office 2-3 days per week.

Why You Should Join Us

- Learning and Development: Join a friendly, supportive environment where you will work directly with our IT Director and team on new technology rollouts. We encourage continuous learning, helping you build experience across systems, cloud tools and workplace tech.

- Culture of Celebration: We pride ourselves on creating a collaborative and fun work environment with regular team events and activities.

- Competitive Rewards: Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including a competitive salary, phone & travel reimbursements, remote work allowance, and a Onefit membership discount.

- Work-Life Balance: We offer flexibility with a hybrid working environment that lets you balance personal and professional commitments.Fuel Your Day: Enjoy a healthy and delicious daily lunch from our extensive organic buffet.

- Weekly Unwind: Take advantage of our weekly massage sessions to de-stress and relax.

- Centrally Located: Our office is conveniently situated near the station for easy commuting.

- Career Growth Opportunities: We're committed to your professional development, offering continuous learning and internal promotion opportunities.

Join Us Now and Be Part of the Future

Artefact is experiencing exciting growth, and this is the perfect time to join our dynamic team and contribute to our success story.

Please note that we can only consider candidates who are already residing in the Netherlands and do not require visa sponsorship.

Come join us!

- Manage end-to-end logistics: venue hire, invitations and communications, printing, catering and on-the-day coordination.

- Track attendance, follow-up and outcomes to show the value of each event.

- Identify external AI and industry events the company can participate in, and secure stage speaking slots for Artefact UK leaders.

Awards

- Identify relevant industry and data awards to nominate the company for.

- Manage the full nomination process, including drafting submissions, gathering client and project input, and coordinating internally to meet deadlines.

PR and external agencies

- Support the CEO in managing the external PR agency, including briefing, coordinating timelines and tracking coverage.

Budget and reporting

- Maintain and report on the marketing budget, split by industry and central pot, flagging variances early.

- Support global reporting requirements and liaise with the Global Marketing Lead to ensure UK activity is aligned and visible.

Employee events and communications

- Organise key company events, such as the summer and Christmas parties, from venue and supplier selection to budget and logistics.

- Manage internal communications around these events.

About You

- 3-5 years' experience in a marketing role, with experience in a professional services, consulting or SaaS business being a must.

- Hands-on experience managing LinkedIn company pages and running LinkedIn advertising campaigns.

- Proven experience organising corporate events, including venue, supplier and catering management.

- Confident managing and reporting on budgets, with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Working knowledge of PPC and SEO, and experience working with external agencies, is a plus.

- Excellent written communication and attention to detail.

- Able to work independently, prioritise across several workstreams and work comfortably with senior stakeholders, including partners and the CEO.

- Comfortable working with a global team and contributing to cross-country reporting.

What We Offer

- Close exposure to the UK CEO and Lead Partners, with real ownership from day one.

- A varied role spanning digital, events, PR and reporting.

- Hybrid working, based in London.

- A collaborative culture within an international group.

Artefact is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

postings.title: Marketing Specialist (B2B, Lead Generation)
postings.description:
About us 

Artefact is an applied AI company. We build systems that run in production, in our clients' own cloud, and keep running after we leave. We are present in 27 countries across all continents with a team of 2,500 employees, offering a comprehensive set of AI & data solutions built on deep data science and cutting-edge AI technologies.

From strategy to operations, we partner with 1,000+ clients, including some of the world’s top 300 brands such as Samsung, L’Oréal and Sanofi. Here in the Netherlands, our clients include Rituals, Heineken, Ahold Delhaize, Basic-Fit and more. Our work spans the full data and AI value chain, including data strategy, data quality and governance, data platforms, AI solutions, and data-driven customer experiences.

We’re looking for an independent, driven marketer with a B2B background to join our team in Utrecht. You’ll work closely with our partners, department heads and consultants, as well as with Artefact’s global Marketing team, so fluency in Dutch and English is essential.

The role

As Marketing Specialist, you help turn prospects into clients. You’ll plan and run demand and lead generation campaigns, from events and award applications to thought-leadership content, LinkedIn and paid campaigns, in close collaboration with senior stakeholders.

What you’ll do

- Social media: Develop our LinkedIn lead generation strategy and manage employer branding on Instagram.

- Digital advertising: Run organic and paid campaigns on Google Ads and LinkedIn to build awareness, generate leads and increase the visibility of our partners.

- Website: Keep website content, blog articles, event pages and client cases up to date, with regular checks on UX, consistency and SEO.

- Events and webinars: Plan and deliver webinars, business breakfasts, podcasts and trade fair or conference appearances, and promote them across our website, landing pages, email and social channels (LinkedIn and X).

- Planning and budget: Build and execute the annual marketing plan with senior management, manage the budget, and tailor campaigns to client needs together with Client Leads and Directors.

- Content: Work with senior management to identify topics and speakers, and refine content, presentations and RFPs with support from copywriters and designers.

- PR and awards: Define our award strategy, support teams with submissions, and spread key messages through the right channels.

- CRM and automation: Use Pardot to launch email, newsletter and landing page campaigns, and qualify and assign prospects to Lead Managers based on international criteria.

What you bring

- Fluent Dutch and English, written and spoken.

- 1-2 years of experience in B2B marketing, including internships or apprenticeships, preferably with hands-on work in lead generation, LinkedIn campaigns or event marketing.

- Strong project management and decision-making skills, and comfort with multitasking and deadlines.

- Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation tools such as Salesforce.

- LinkedIn expertise, both organic and paid.

- Excellent writing, editing and presentation skills, including copywriting.

- A team player who enjoys working with marketing colleagues around the world, with a genuine interest in tech and lead generation.

Why you should join us

- Learning and development: Join a team of passionate digital consultants always ready to help each other, providing opportunities to learn and collaborate with some of the best in the field.

- Culture of celebration: We take pride in our work and celebrate successes together. Expect regular team events, fun activities, and a collaborative spirit that makes coming to work enjoyable.

- Competitive rewards: We offer a comprehensive benefits package including a competitive salary, phone and travel reimbursements, a remote work allowance, a Onefit membership discount, and the laptop of your choice.

- Work-life balance: Maintain a healthy balance with a hybrid work environment that allows flexibility.

- Fuel your day: Enjoy a delicious and healthy lunch provided daily with an extensive organic buffet.

- Weekly unwind : Relieve stress and promote relaxation with a weekly massage session from our office physiotherapist.

- Centrally located: Our Utrecht office is conveniently situated next to the station for easy commuting.

Come join us! 

If you're unsure whether your experience matches the requirements but are highly motivated, don't hesitate to reach out to us. We’d love to hear from you!

postings.title: Platform Engineer
postings.description:
Mission

Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production.

Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context & Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

Vos responsabilités :

- 

Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud.

- 

Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.

- 

Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.

- 

Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.

- 

Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.

- 

Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.

- 

Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent.

- 

Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

- 

Vous avez construit et exploité de l’infrastructure cloud sur Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS, en infrastructure as code.

- 

Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique.

- 

Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles réseau, gestion des secrets) s’appliquent chez vous au quotidien.

- 

Ce que vous exploitez, vous le surveillez, et vous prenez part à la gestion des incidents.

- 

Le code et la documentation que vous écrivez restent maintenables pour les équipes qui utilisent votre plateforme.

- 

Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

- 

Une expérience de plateformes de données, par exemple sur Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake.

- 

Une expérience MLOps ou LLMOps : serving de modèles, model registry, pipelines d’évaluation.

- 

Une expérience d’observabilité d’agents ou de LLM gateway : tracing, suivi des coûts, routage.

- 

FinOps : suivi et optimisation des coûts.

- 

Sécurité de l’IA : droits d’accès des agents, red teaming, guardrails.

- 

Une certification cloud.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Le Platform Engineer travaille à l’endroit où ces questions se posent en premier, au plus près des équipes techniques et de sécurité du client.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : serving de modèles, observabilité des agents, sécurité de l’IA, avec l’appui de la communauté Platform Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Platform Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Une spécialisation en sécurité de l’IA (red teaming, guardrails, conformité à l’AI Act) est possible : elle relève aujourd’hui de l’archétype Platform Engineer. Plus tard, un rôle transverse s’ouvre (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), et les Platform Engineers seniors peuvent rejoindre le chapter AI Architect.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

- 

Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

- 

Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

- 

Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

- 

Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

- 

Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

- 

Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

postings.title: Platform Engineer
postings.location: Capital Tower, Boulevard Mly Youssef, Casablanca, Maroc
postings.description:
Mission

Join the most advanced community of AI makers.

The world's leading companies run their AI on what you build. You design and run the foundations that make their applications and agents work at scale: cloud infrastructure, data platforms, delivery pipelines, model serving and the runtime that agents run on. Your work lets product teams ship safely and keeps cost, latency and security under control.

This role is for you if your users are other engineers and you care about what happens at scale.

Artefact is the trusted AI deployment team to the world's leading companies. In France, you join its Engineering department, about 300 people, in the AI Applied Engineer chapter and the Platform Engineer archetype.

Activities & Responsibilities

Who you work with

Product Engineers and AI Engineers deploy on the platforms you build. You agree with them on what they need and support them in production. 
On a data platform, you own the foundation: infrastructure, security, network and compute. Context Engineers own what flows in it. You also work with the client's IT, security and cloud teams, review code with your peers and help newer colleagues.

What you do

- Set up cloud infrastructure as code and run cloud migrations.

- Build CI/CD pipelines, and MLOps and LLMOps tooling.

- Build reusable deployment templates, shared services, self-service environments and engineering accelerators

- Build the agent harness: runtime, evaluation tooling, observability.

- Serve models and control their cost and latency.

- Put security foundations in place: IAM, networking, secrets, agent access rights, protection against prompt injection.

- Build connectors and MCP servers that several agents reuse.

- Own reliability: monitoring, incident handling, cost reporting.

Required Skills

Must-haves:

- You have built and run cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud, Azure or AWS, using infrastructure as code.

- You set up CI/CD pipelines and containerised deployments, for example on Kubernetes.

- You apply security basics in your daily work: IAM, network rules, secrets management.

- You monitor what you run and take part in incident handling.

- You write maintainable code and documentation for the engineers who use your platform.

- You already use coding agents in your daily work and check what they produce.

Bonus, not required:

- Data platform experience, for example on Databricks, BigQuery or Snowflake.

- MLOps or LLMOps experience: model serving, model registry, evaluation pipelines.

- Agent observability or LLM gateway experience: tracing, cost tracking, routing.

- FinOps: cost reporting and optimisation.

- AI security: agent access rights, red teaming, guardrails.

- A cloud certification.

You don't need to tick every box to apply. If you match most must-haves and want to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

On a data platform, you own the foundation: infrastructure, security, network and compute. Context Engineers own what flows in it. You also work with the client's IT, security and cloud teams, review code with your peers and help newer colleagues.

What you do

- Set up cloud infrastructure as code and run cloud migrations.

- Build CI/CD pipelines, and MLOps and LLMOps tooling.

- Build reusable deployment templates, shared services, self-service environments and engineering accelerators

- Build the agent harness: runtime, evaluation tooling, observability.

- Serve models and control their cost and latency.

- Put security foundations in place: IAM, networking, secrets, agent access rights, protection against prompt injection.

- Build connectors and MCP servers that several agents reuse.

- Own reliability: monitoring, incident handling, cost reporting.

Required Skills

Must-haves:

- You have built and run cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud, Azure or AWS, using infrastructure as code.

- You set up CI/CD pipelines and containerised deployments, for example on Kubernetes.

- You apply security basics in your daily work: IAM, network rules, secrets management.

- You monitor what you run and take part in incident handling.

- You write maintainable code and documentation for the engineers who use your platform.

- You already use coding agents in your daily work and check what they produce.

Bonus, not required:

- Data platform experience, for example on Databricks, BigQuery or Snowflake.

- MLOps or LLMOps experience: model serving, model registry, evaluation pipelines.

- Agent observability or LLM gateway experience: tracing, cost tracking, routing.

- FinOps: cost reporting and optimisation.

- AI security: agent access rights, red teaming, guardrails.

- A cloud certification.

You don't need to tick every box to apply. If you match most must-haves and want to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

postings.title: Product Engineer
postings.description:
Mission

Ce que vous construisez ne reste pas à l’état de démonstration : de vrais utilisateurs, au sein de grands groupes, s’en servent chaque jour. Applications et agents se conçoivent et s’exploitent en binôme avec l’AI Product Manager. Une équipe sinistres retrouve ainsi sur un seul écran les documents utiles et un brouillon de réponse ; ailleurs, un processus de commande ne demande plus aucune ressaisie manuelle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que de vrais utilisateurs s’appuient sur ce que vous livrez.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Product Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

À chaque projet, l’AI Product Manager pilote le produit avec le client : ce qui se construit en premier, et la vérification que les utilisateurs s’en servent, se décident à deux.

Autour de l’application, trois métiers se croisent : les AI Engineers pour le comportement du modèle, les Platform Engineers pour le déploiement, les Context & Analytics Engineers pour les données dont l’application a besoin. Les tests se font avec les utilisateurs finaux, le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

Vos responsabilités :

- 

Construire des applications métier : front end, back end et API.

- 

Intégrer des agents et des assistants dans un processus métier, avec des contrôles humains là où ils comptent.

- 

Automatiser des processus de bout en bout.

- 

Intégrer un modèle dans un outil que les équipes utilisent déjà.

- 

Construire les connecteurs dont le cas d’usage a besoin, par exemple un serveur MCP pour un outil métier.

- 

Concevoir l’expérience utilisateur de l’IA : quand une personne valide, comment afficher les sources et l’incertitude.

- 

Définir avec l’AI Product Manager les évaluations propres au cas d’usage et les suivre en production.

- 

Assumer ce que vous livrez après la mise en production : monitoring, incidents, adoption.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

- 

Vous avez construit des applications avec un front end, un back end et des API, même si votre expertise est plus marquée d’un côté.

- 

Du code testé, relu et documenté, en Python, TypeScript ou dans un langage similaire.

- 

Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

- 

Des besoins d’utilisateurs transformés en une première version, puis améliorée à partir de leurs retours.

- 

Le monitoring, les incidents et l’adoption font, pour vous, partie du métier.

- 

Une aisance à expliquer vos choix techniques à des personnes non techniques.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

- 

Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.

- 

Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.

- 

Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.

- 

Une expérience au contact des clients.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : conception d’agents, évaluation par cas d’usage, expérience utilisateur de l’IA, avec l’appui des AI Engineers et de la communauté Product Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Product Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme le chapter AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

- 

Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

- 

Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

- 

Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

- 

Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

- 

Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

- 

Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

postings.title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
postings.description:
Contexte :

Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.

L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).

Présentation d’Artefact :

Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.

Sujet :

Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.

Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.

Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible et facile à adopter.

Pré-requis

Le profil recherché pour ce poste est le suivant :
BAC+4/BAC+5 : Formation en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques ou machine learning au sein d’une université ou école d’ingénieur
Stage de césure ou stage de fin d’études
Date de début : Hiver 2026-2027
Durée : 4 à 6 mois

Références

- Risser, L., Sanz, A. G., Vincenot, Q., & Loubes, J. M. (2022). Tackling algorithmic bias in neural-network classifiers using wasserstein-2 regularization. Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision, 64(6), 672-689.

- Buolamwini, J., & Gebru, T. (2018, January). Gender shades: Intersectional accuracy disparities in commercial gender classification. In Conference on fairness, accountability and transparency (pp. 77-91). PMLR.

- Cho, J., Zala, A., & Bansal, M. (2023, October). Dall-eval: Probing the reasoning skills and social biases of text-to-image generation models. In 2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) (pp. 3020-3031). IEEE.

- Li, X., Chen, Z., Zhang, J. M., Sarro, F., Zhang, Y., & Liu, X. (2023). Dark-skin individuals are at more risk on the street: Unmasking fairness issues of autonomous driving systems. CoRR abs/2308.02935.

- Thong, W., Joniak, P., & Xiang, A. (2023, October). Beyond skin tone: A multidimensional measure of apparent skin color. In 2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) (pp. 4880-4890). IEEE.

- Shilova, V., Malherbe, E., Palma, G., Risser, L., & Loubes, J. M. (2025). Fairness-aware grouping for continuous sensitive variables: Application for debiasing face analysis with respect to skin tone. In ECAI 2025: 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence 25-30 October 2025, Bologna, Italy-Including 14th Conference on Prestigious Applications of Intelligent Systems (PAIS 2025) Proceedings (pp. 5344-5351).

- Mary, J., Calauzenes, C., & El Karoui, N. (2019, May). Fairness-aware learning for continuous attributes and treatments. In International conference on machine learning(pp. 4382-4391). PMLR.

- Giuliani, L., Misino, E., & Lombardi, M. (2023, July). Generalized disparate impact for configurable fairness solutions in ML. In International Conference on Machine Learning (pp. 11443-11458). PMLR.

postings.title: Senior AI Context Engineer
postings.description:
Who we are

- Artefact is a leading global consulting firm dedicated to accelerating the adoption of data and AI. We work with a variety of businesses, from supermarket chains, to private equity firms and telecoms; including Nissan, L'Oréal, Carrefour, WHSmith, Orange, Beiersdorf, BNP Paribas, and Samsung.

- Our success stems from combining advanced data technologies, agile methods for quick delivery, and dedicated teams of data scientists, data engineers, business consultants, and data analysts.

- Our 1,800 employees operate in 25 countries (Americas, Europe, Asia, Middle East, India, Africa) and we partner with 1,000+ clients.

What you will be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist in our London office, your role will encompass:

- Designing and implementing advanced data science and machine learning solutions to solve complex business problems.

- Taking ownership of project streams, from defining technical deliverables and timelines to presenting updates to client steering committees.

- Supervising and mentoring team members on code, deployment, and best practices.

- Architecting and deploying robust, scalable solutions using modern cloud technologies and MLOps principles.

Qualifications

Necessary education and experience

- Education: A Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

- Project & Team Leadership: Demonstrable experience supervising team members, taking responsibility for project delivery, defining technical tasks, and presenting project updates to both internal and client stakeholders.

- Advanced Modelling: Proven ability to implement a range of complex models such as time-series forecasting, gradient boosting, clustering, NLP, and Bayesian inference.

- ML-Ops & Orchestration: Strong experience with MLOps tools for orchestration, experiment tracking, hyper-parameter tuning, and deploying automated model retraining pipelines.

- Programming & Data Engineering: Proficiency in object-oriented Python, advanced dataframes (Polars/Pyspark), and data versioning (DVC). Experience designing data storage solutions and using object-oriented SQL interfaces.

- Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with at least two major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including app deployment, database services (e.g., RDS, CosmosDB), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform). Solid understanding of CI/CD for testing and containerisation.

Desirable experience

- Advanced Education: A Master's degree or PhD in a relevant field is a strong plus.

- Parallelisation & Performance: Experience with parallelisation frameworks like Pyspark or Ray.

- Advanced Cloud & Infrastructure: Familiarity with serverless deployments (e.g., Fargate, Lambdas), infrastructure automation with Terratest or Ansible.

postings.title: Senior, AI & Data Science
postings.description:
Join the most advanced community of AI makers.

This role is in the ML & AI Applied Scientist archetype of the AI Applied Engineer chapter. Everyone in the chapter has the same title and the same foundation skills. Each person also has one main archetype, defined by the layer of the system they build, with skills specific to that archetype.

Mission

New models arrive every month, open or closed: you choose which ones are good enough for production, and you prove it. You build applications and agents on top of large language models (LLMs) and make the model part work. Our clients use these systems to answer customers, process documents and search their own knowledge.

You decide what context the model gets, how it retrieves knowledge and which tools it can call. You measure how good its answers are, and choose the model that fits the cost and quality target.

When an off-the-shelf model is not enough, you also build and adapt the models themselves: forecasting and optimisation engines, fine-tuned or distilled models, and the evaluation frameworks that prove a model is good enough.

This role is for you if you want to know whether an AI system gives correct answers, not only whether it runs.

Who you work with

Product Engineers build the application around the model; you own how the model behaves inside it. Context & Analytics Engineers prepare the knowledge your agents retrieve, and Platform Engineers own the shared harness, runtime and model-serving infrastructure; you own the agent logic and behaviour that runs on it.

With the AI Product Manager and the client's domain experts, you define what a good answer is and review results together. You review code with your peers and help newer colleagues.

What you do

- Build machine learning applications, such as scoring or time series forecasting, with all the necessary steps: data wrangling, training loops, cross validation, evaluation, and deployment.

- Build LLM applications and agents: context design, tool calling, multi-step workflows.

- Design how agents use knowledge: retrieval queries, re-ranking, citations.

- Build evaluation sets and pipelines: reference answers, automated scoring, review by domain experts.

- Track answer quality in production and fix what degrades.

- Choose models by quality, cost and latency. Fine-tune or distil a smaller model when prompting is not enough.

- Add guardrails against wrong answers, data leaks and prompt injection.

- Process documents with LLMs: extraction, classification, summaries.

- Frame the modelling problem with the AI Product Manager and the business: the objective, the constraints and the metric that matters.

- Build forecasting and optimisation engines, and take them to production with Platform Engineers.

- Design evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for models and agents, including reinforcement learning where it helps.

- Run model research and benchmarking, and turn the results into reusable assets for the chapter.

- Explain model behaviour, uncertainty and limits to business stakeholders.

Required Skills

Must-haves:

- You have built an application or agent that calls an LLM, and you can explain where it worked and where it failed.

- You write tested, maintainable code.

- You already use coding agents in your daily work and check what they produce.

- You measure AI output quality with test sets and metrics, and you know how to limit made-up answers, prompt injection and data leaks.

- You know what it takes to put an LLM application in production and keep it there: deployment, monitoring, cost and latency.

- You start from the business problem, not the model, and you can explain to non-engineers when AI is not the right tool.

- You have a solid foundation in machine learning and statistics: you can explain why a model works and when it will fail.

Bonus, not required:

- Fine-tuning or distillation of language models.

- Agent frameworks or protocols such as MCP.

- Multimodal inputs: documents, images, speech.

- LLM observability tools: tracing, cost tracking.

- Forecasting, optimisation or reinforcement learning in production.

- Publications, patents or open-source models.

You don't need to tick every box to apply. If you match most must-haves and want to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

Tech grid skills that matter most: ML, Optimization & Foundation Models; Applied Math, Statistics & AI Evaluation; AI & Agentic Solutions.

Certifications (a plus): Databricks Machine Learning Professional, Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer.

Interview focus: Technical interview: maths, ML and LLM evaluation fundamentals. System design: go deep on the model or agent behaviour and how you evaluate it. Hands-on build: an LLM or ML component for the case and the evaluation that proves it works.

Foundation skills, whatever your archetype

- Software craft: write code that is tested, reviewed and documented.

- Production ownership: own what you ship after launch, including monitoring, incidents and fixes.

- AI evaluation: define and run evaluations for AI features, and say when AI is not the right tool.

- AI system security basics: manage access rights and secrets, and guard against prompt injection.

- AI-assisted development: write the specification, delegate to coding agents, review the result and keep token costs under control.

- Product and business sense: build for users, ship a first version, measure adoption, improve it.

- Client relationship: explain your choices to clients and manage your part of the project.

What we expect at your level

- Senior: owns a workstream of their archetype end to end, splits and estimates the work, reviews code and works autonomously with the client.

What to expect / Recruitment process

The process has five interviews. You don't need to choose an archetype before applying: after the HR interview, interviews 2 to 4 are run by engineers from the archetype that fits your experience, with a case from that archetype. Each archetype's interview focus is described in its section above.

- HR interview (45 min): your background and current situation, your fit (autonomy, client posture, teamwork) and your interest in building AI systems.

- Technical interview (60 min) with an engineer from your archetype: the fundamentals of your archetype (live coding for Product and Context & Analytics, cloud and DevOps for Platform, maths, ML and LLM evaluation for ML & AI Applied Scientists), then a deep dive on something you built.

- System design (60 min) with two engineers from different archetypes: design the AI system for a client use case, go deep on your part (application, platform, data and context, or model) and defend your choices.

- Hands-on build (60 min) with an engineer from your archetype: build a working piece of the previous case with the tools of your choice, AI coding assistants included, then demo it and walk through it.

- Fit interview (30 min) with a Director: meet the team and learn how we work.

About Artefact

Artefact is the trusted AI deployment team to the world's leading companies: 3,000 AI makers in more than 30 countries and more than 1,000 clients. In the US, you join the Engineering & Deployment department, in the AI Applied Engineer chapter.

Diversity & Inclusion

Artefact is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skills and potential, and we welcome applicants of every background, identity and experience. If you need an adjustment at any step of the hiring process, tell your recruiter.

Why Join Us

We are united by our values and strengthened by our hybrid expertise.

- There is always a way: We're from the breed of does, of diggers, of makers. Because ideas are valuable only if executed.

- Client trust is won on the field: Addressing client needs flows better hands on at their side.

- If not used, it is useless: Our love for technology translates into a steep desire for adoption, true brilliance is about impact.

- If not shared, our work is not done: Sharing knowledge is the best way to button up a mission, benefitting clients and colleagues.

- We learn everyday: Tech is a land where everything moves at the speed of light, you better be ready to challenge yourself.

How We Support Our People

In addition to our values-driven culture, we offer a range of benefits and programs designed to support our employees' growth and well-being, including:

- Learning and Development: Work alongside a multidisciplinary team of AI, data, and consulting experts who are committed to continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional growth.

- Hybrid Flexibility: Our hybrid work model gives you the flexibility to balance collaboration, client needs, and personal commitments.

- Comprehensive Benefits: We offer a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company matching, and paid parental leave.

- Time to Recharge: We believe sustainable performance matters. That's why we offer unlimited paid time off, giving you the flexibility to take the time you need.

- Growth Opportunities: As a rapidly growing organization, you'll have the opportunity to expand your skills, take on new challenges, and help shape the future of the company.

postings.title: Senior Paid Social Account Manager
postings.description:
Senior Paid Social Account Manager

About the role

Artefact is looking for an experienced Senior Paid Social Account Manager to take senior ownership of paid social activity across two key client accounts.

This is a hands-on role combining account strategy, technical auditing, campaign management, optimisation, performance analysis and senior client management. The successful candidate will be expected to understand the detail of platform execution while also providing clear strategic direction and identifying opportunities to grow client performance and the wider relationship.

Strong Meta expertise is essential. The person should be able to inherit an existing account, independently assess whether the setup is technically and strategically sound, identify weaknesses or missed opportunities, prioritise improvements and lead their implementation.

The role will initially focus on two clients, allowing the Senior Paid Social Account Manager to build a deep understanding of their businesses, act as a trusted paid social adviser and take genuine accountability for account quality and performance.

Key responsibilities

Account leadership and client strategy

- Act as the senior day-to-day paid social lead for the assigned clients, owning the relationship for the channel and ensuring consistently high-quality delivery.

- Develop a deep understanding of each client’s business model, commercial priorities, customer journey and wider media strategy.

- Translate business objectives into clear paid social strategies, investment recommendations, testing roadmaps and activation plans.

- Present strategic recommendations, performance insights and account priorities confidently to senior client stakeholders.

- Challenge existing approaches constructively and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance or expand the role of paid social.

- Coordinate with Search, Programmatic, Retail Media, Commerce, Influencer, Creative and Data teams to provide integrated recommendations.

- Support annual, quarterly and campaign-level planning, including budget allocation, forecasting and scenario planning.

Meta account audits and technical setup

A core part of the role will be independently assessing whether existing Meta environments are correctly structured for activation, optimisation and measurement.

- Business Portfolio / Business Manager setup, permissions and governance.

- Ad account structure and campaign architecture.

- Domain, page, Instagram and other asset configuration.

- Meta Pixel, Conversions API, events and conversion optimisation setup.

- Data quality, event match quality and potential tracking gaps.

- Product catalogues, feeds and commerce integrations where relevant.

- Audience strategy, exclusions and first-party data activation.

- Budget, bidding and optimisation configuration.

- Attribution and measurement settings.

- Naming conventions, campaign taxonomy and account governance.

- Creative, placement and format setup.

- Account-level automated settings and relevant platform recommendations.

- Integration with analytics, ecommerce and measurement environments.

The Senior Paid Social Account Manager should be able to document audit findings clearly, distinguish critical issues from lower-priority improvements, build an action plan and either implement or coordinate the required changes.

Paid social strategy and planning

- Develop paid social strategies aligned with client business, media and commercial objectives.

- Define the role of different paid social platforms, audiences, creative formats and campaign objectives within the wider media mix.

- Build structured testing roadmaps covering audiences, creative, formats, placements, bidding and new platform capabilities.

- Recommend how paid social should work alongside influencer and creator activity, including paid amplification of creator content.

- Identify opportunities to improve incrementality, efficiency and scale rather than focusing solely on platform-reported performance.

- Provide clear recommendations on where investment should be increased, reduced or reallocated.

Campaign management and optimisation

- Retain sufficient hands-on involvement to understand account performance and ensure execution remains strong.

- Oversee campaign setup, structures, audiences, bidding, budgets, placements and creative deployment.

- Ensure campaigns are launched accurately and on time, with appropriate QA and measurement foundations.

- Monitor pacing and performance against agreed objectives and proactively identify issues.

- Lead optimisation decisions and ensure actions are based on evidence rather than routine platform changes.

- Maintain strong account hygiene, documentation and platform best practice.

- Review work completed by more junior team members where relevant and provide clear guidance and quality control.

Platform expertise

Meta

Advanced hands-on Meta experience is essential. The successful candidate should be highly confident across:

- Meta Ads Manager and Business Portfolio / Business Manager.

- Campaign architecture and account restructuring.

- Audience strategy and first-party data activation.

- Advantage+ solutions.

- Conversion, catalogue and ecommerce campaigns.

- Creative testing and Reels/video formats.

- Partnership Ads and creator-led paid amplification.

- Pixel, Conversions API, events and conversion optimisation.

- Product catalogues and feeds.

- Budget and bidding strategies.

- Attribution, measurement and experimentation.

- Account troubleshooting, audits and governance.

The person should be comfortable inheriting an account they have never seen before and quickly determining whether the foundations are strong, what is limiting performance and whether restructuring is required.

TikTok

Strong TikTok Ads experience is highly desirable, including:

- Campaign setup, optimisation and account structure.

- Spark Ads and creator-led paid amplification.

- Audience and creative testing.

- Performance analysis and budget optimisation.

- Understanding of how paid media can connect with TikTok Shop activity where relevant.

Other platforms

Experience with additional paid social environments is beneficial, particularly:

- LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

- Pinterest.

- YouTube / Google video environments.

- Emerging social and creator-led advertising platforms.

The successful candidate does not need equal expertise across every platform, but should be curious, adaptable and able to expand into new environments as client needs evolve.

Performance, measurement and insights

- Analyse performance across campaigns, audiences, creatives, placements and conversion journeys.

- Explain the drivers behind performance changes rather than simply report results.

- Translate platform metrics into clear commercial implications and recommendations.

- Work with analytics specialists where deeper measurement support is required.

- Support experimentation, incrementality, attribution and other measurement initiatives where relevant.

- Ensure reporting focuses on decisions and next actions, not only retrospective performance.

- Maintain accurate budget tracking, campaign documentation and key account-change records.

Creative and creator collaboration

Paid social performance increasingly depends on creative quality. The role will therefore work closely with clients, creative teams and influencer specialists.

- Develop creative testing frameworks and identify high-performing themes, formats and messages.

- Translate campaign data into actionable creative recommendations.

- Advise on platform-specific creative best practice.

- Identify opportunities to use influencer and creator content within paid campaigns.

- Recommend opportunities for Spark Ads, Partnership Ads and other creator-led formats.

- Feed paid-media learnings back into future content and creator planning.

Commercial ownership and capability development

Client delivery is the core responsibility, but at Senior Account Manager level we also expect the person to contribute to account growth and the wider development of Artefact’s paid social capability.

- Identify growth opportunities within existing client accounts and turn them into clear recommendations or proposals.

- Spot relevant cross-sell opportunities across media, commerce, influencer and measurement capabilities.

- Support pitches, new-business proposals and client growth initiatives.

- Help develop a repeatable Meta audit framework and paid social best-practice standards for the wider team.

- Build relationships with Meta, TikTok and other relevant platform partners.

- Stay close to new platform products, betas and market developments and assess their relevance for clients.

- Develop case studies, training materials and internal knowledge sharing.

- Contribute to improving paid social processes, governance and ways of working.

Team contribution and mentoring

- Provide guidance, QA and coaching to more junior paid media team members where relevant.

- Help raise the overall standard of paid social knowledge across the team.

- Delegate appropriately while remaining accountable for the quality of client output.

- Create an environment where issues are identified early and recommendations are proactive rather than reactive.

What we are looking for

Essential

- Strong hands-on paid social experience, ideally within an agency or multi-client environment.

- Advanced Meta Ads expertise and confidence operating at both strategic and technical levels.

- Proven experience auditing existing Meta accounts and identifying setup, tracking, structure and optimisation issues.

- Ability to independently assess whether an account is correctly configured and prioritise the required changes.

- Strong knowledge of Meta Pixel, Conversions API, events and conversion measurement.

- Experience restructuring or materially improving existing accounts.

- Strong campaign-management, optimisation and analytical skills.

- Experience developing audience, creative and campaign testing strategies.

- Ability to translate complex performance data into clear strategic and commercial recommendations.

- Strong client-management skills and confidence presenting to senior stakeholders.

- Experience taking ownership of multiple workstreams and priorities across client accounts.

- Strong attention to detail, accountability and a proactive approach to identifying problems and opportunities.

- Commercial mindset and willingness to contribute to account growth and new opportunities.

Highly desirable

- Strong hands-on TikTok Ads experience.

- Experience with ecommerce and catalogue-based Meta activity.

- Experience with creator-led paid media, including Spark Ads and Meta Partnership Ads.

- Experience working with retail, ecommerce or consumer brands.

- Knowledge of product feeds and catalogue management.

- Experience working alongside influencer, retail-media or commerce teams.

- Experience with experimentation, attribution and incrementality measurement.

- Experience participating in pitches, proposals or account-growth initiatives.

- Experience mentoring or reviewing the work of more junior team members.

Nice to have

- LinkedIn Ads experience.

- Pinterest experience.

- TikTok Shop knowledge.

- Google Analytics / GA4 knowledge.

- Looker Studio or similar reporting experience.

- Experience working across multiple European markets.

What success looks like

In the first few months, we would expect this person to:

- Independently audit both client Meta environments and clearly prioritise the changes required.

- Take senior ownership of paid social strategy and ongoing activation across both accounts.

- Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and become the go-to paid social adviser.

- Improve performance through structured optimisation, experimentation and stronger creative insight.

- Establish strong account, tracking and measurement foundations.

- Bring proactive recommendations and growth opportunities rather than waiting for client requests.

- Connect paid social more effectively with creative, influencer, commerce and wider media activity.

- Raise delivery standards through strong QA, documentation and guidance to other team members.

- Contribute to the development of Artefact’s paid social capability and commercial growth.

postings.title: Senior Programmatic Display Consultant
postings.description:
Who we are

Artefact is an applied AI company. We build systems that run in production, in our clients' own cloud, and keep running after we leave. We are present in 27 countries across all continents with a team of 2,500 employees, offering a comprehensive set of AI & data solutions built on deep data science and cutting-edge AI technologies.

From strategy to operations, we partner with 1,000+ clients, including some of the world’s top 300 brands such as Samsung, L’Oréal and Sanofi.
